LEGIO

From the Gallic frontier to the gates of Rome

v0.3 - Acts I and II: eleven battles, campaign map, camp phase.

Controls
Left click / drag: select · Right click: move or attack
Right drag: draw a battle line (it faces to the left of the way you draw: left-to-right faces north, right-to-left south) · Wheel: zoom · WASD / arrows: pan
Space pause · Z X C speed 1x/2x/4x · - / = slower / faster (down to 0.5x) · Q select all
Ctrl + right-click marches without stopping to fight
Friendly units never shove each other: a unit marching through a friend moves at a crawl.
Ctrl+1-9 set control group · 1-9 recall (double-tap: centre camera)
E select your general, E again to centre on him; or click his gold standard, or the arrow at the screen edge when he is out of view (right-click to move; cohorts inside the gold ring recover and rally faster)
· V range rings · Esc deselect
Arcs under a unit: green front, yellow flanks, red rear.
You can give orders while paused. Hit enemy flanks and rears; rout breaks armies.
